title: keystore write: enforce PIN length max
description: wp11_keystore_create calls wc_PBKDF2(pin, (int)pinlen, ...) without checking that pinlen <= INT_MAX. If pinlen > INT_MAX, the cast to int is implementation-defined (UB in C99) and wolfCrypt may silently truncate or misinterpret the length. PKCS#11 2.40 §11.5 sets CKK_VENDOR_DEFINED so the library sets the maximum; a reasonable cap is WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_PIN_LEN (or 256 bytes). Fix: add a check for pinlen > WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_PIN_LEN before the PBKDF2 call in wp11_keystore_create (mirror the check that already exists in wp11_keystore_open). Document the cap in wolfp11/wp11_settings.h.
